#ad One second dinner is served, and the next second it vanishes into thin air. Spreading soft food across the raised bumps helps stretch out meals, distract during bath time, and offer some quiet focus. Swipe through the slides to see how it works and where to use it. Please keep in mind, this soft rubber dish is meant for licking, not for dogs that chew or tear.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/

#slowfeeder #dogbowl #dogenrichment #dogcare
brief: Wobble lick bowl for dogs: a rubber bowl full of small bumps. Spread wet food or a treat paste into the bumps, and licking it up takes longer, so fast eaters slow down and mealtime lasts. Good for fast eaters, bath time and quiet time. Not for dogs that chew or tear soft rubber. Playful tone: dinner served, dinner gone. This is a 5-slide swipe post, so invite people to swipe.
